description: This file is a header defining logging interfaces, enums, macros, and C++ namespace functions for the Rialto logging system. It includes log level and component definitions, external function declarations, macros for logging, and C++ functions for setting log levels and handlers.

classes.name: firebolt::rialto::logging::LogHandler
classes.description: Type alias for a function handling log messages, used for setting custom log handlers.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for a specific component, overwriting previous levels.

methods.name: getLogLevels
methods.description: Retrieves the current logging levels for a specific component.

methods.name: setLogHandler
methods.description: Sets a custom log handler function for a specific component.

methods.name: isConsoleLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging to console is enabled.
